basic_profile.bio: Originally from São Paulo, Brazil, I'm a 28-year-old financial analyst with a passion for learning and self-improvement. I enjoy diving into books about economy, history, and investments to broaden my understanding of global markets. I also have a fondness for video games, particularly Pokémon, which I play during my downtime. In my free time, I like exploring local markets and cooking new recipes. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM BRT. Currently single, I find joy in connecting with communities that share my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Economics from the University of São Paulo, I have a solid foundation in financial theories and practices. My job as a financial analyst involves constant research and staying updated with market trends, which I often supplement with self-taught knowledge from books and online courses. My understanding of history and investments is further enhanced by my active participation in related online forums and discussions.
